name: The Lullaby Weaver
detailed_description:
The Lullaby Weaver is a 1 bit psychological point & click horror game inspired by games like World of Horror, Silent Hill, & the works of Junji Ito & FAITH. The Lullaby Weaver takes players on a journey of self discovery after Maya loses her grandmother and returns home to settle her estate. Upon arriving at Cold Springs, not everything is as it seems. With the town seemingly empty, and unspeakable creatures roaming freely, Maya must explore, solve puzzles, and avoid getting killed by the horrors that challenge her psyche, to deal with her memories of the past and find the Lullaby Weaver, the fabled entity that could get her free of the pain she carries in her heart. 

Explore a beautiful, yet haunting hand-drawn town full of places to see. Solve meaningful puzzles, & experience side stories that develop on the games underlying lore, that help Maya restore what was lost. With it's richly detailed animations, emotional storytelling, and creepy atmosphere, The Lullaby Weaver promises a memorable experience for fans of the Horror genre. 
 

KEY FEATURES

  • Story Driven Experience: An emotional & psychological horror tale of loss, & the     lengths we go to, to try & restore what was lost. Perfect for players who seek a meaningful & immersive storytelling experience.
     

  •  Intuitive & Engaging gameplay: A seamless point-and-click experience with rewarding interactions, including side stories that compliment the main story.
     

  • Stunning Art & Animation: Stunning hand-drawn visuals paired with smooth hand animated scenes that will capture your attention, & bring the world of The Lullaby Weaver to life.
     

  • A Unique Indie Adventure: A personal hand-crafted horror journey offering a fresh take on the genre, & different from mainstream titles.
     

  • Rogue Like Elements: Change up gameplay with rogue-like elements in certain areas, offering up new ways to play & interact with the game. 
     

  • Monster Design Inspired by Junji Ito: Experience different creatures inspired by the works of Junji Ito, that challenge the players survival instincts & connect the world of psychological horror & the real world.



    Art & animation are at the very core of The Lullaby Weaver. With rotoscoped cutscenes also playing a huge part within the world to help tell the story of The Lullaby Weaver. 



    We are sure player will enjoy the haunting art style that conveys the pain & emptiness found inside the civilians of Cold Springs.



    The music of The Lullaby Weaver will feature a blend of atmospheric, yet unsettling tones during your exploration throughout Cold Springs. Certain key areas will feature their own music & sound effects that coincide with the underlying theme & setting. These pieces were carefully created by Alex Bruyns to help complement the game's emotional, yet unnerving undertones. 

    The sound design of The Lullaby Weaver was especially important to us since it helps convey the message that underlines the game as a whole. Not only this, adding SFX that matched the games visual style helps immerse the player & invoke their feelings while playing.

  • Graphics: Intel Integrated Graphics UHD 6000
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio
  • VR Support: n/a
